Iraklis Thessaloniki (men's basketball)|Iraklis Thessaloniki]] | years16 = 2026–present | team16 = [[Basket Zaragoza|Casademont Zaragoza]] | highlights = * 2x [[Canadian Elite Basketball League|CEBL]] scoring champion ([[2023 CEBL season|2023]], [[2024 CEBL season|2024]]) * 2x [[All-CEBL Team|All-CEBL First Team]] (2023, 2024) * {{nowrap|2× Honorable mention [[NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]] – [[Associated Press|AP]] ([[2018 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|2018]], [[2019 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|2019]])}} * 2× [[Coastal Athletic Association Men's Basketball Player of the Year|CAA Player of the Year]] (2018, 2019) * 2× First-team All-[[Coastal Athletic Association|CAA]] (2018, 2019) * Second-team All-CAA (2017) }} '''Justin Jamel Wright–Foreman''' (born October 27, 1997) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for [[Basket Zaragoza|Casademont Zaragoza]] of the [[Liga ACB]] and the [[FIBA Europe Cup|Europe Cup]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Hofstra Pride men's basketball|Hofstra Pride]]. He was drafted by the [[Utah Jazz]] with the 53rd overall pick in the [[2019 NBA draft]]. == College career == Hofstra coach [[Joe Mihalich]] spotted Wright-Foreman at a basketball tournament in Las Vegas where he scored 48 points in a game and offered him a scholarship. He played sparingly as a freshman due to subpar defense. His breakout game came in a blowout loss to [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky]] as a sophomore, where he scored 14 points. In subsequent games, he upped his scoring average substantially, finishing at 18.5 points per game.{{cite magazine|last1=Fuchs|first1=Jeremy|title=Hofstra's Justin Wright-Foreman Is One of the Best Pure Scorers in the Country|url=https://www.si.com/college-basketball/2018/01/23/hofstra-justin-wright-foreman-third-points-leader|access-date=April 7, 2018|magazine=[[Sports Illustrated]]|date=January 23, 2018}} As a junior, Wright-Foreman averaged 24.2 points per game, fifth-highest in [[NCAA Division I]]. He also contributed 3.1 assists per game, ninth in the [[Coastal Athletic Association|Colonial Athletic Association]] (CAA). He scored over 30 points in seven games. At the conclusion of the regular season he was named [[Coastal Athletic Association Men's Basketball Player of the Year|CAA Player of the Year]].{{cite web|last1=Washburn|first1=Rob|title=WRIGHT-FOREMAN TOPS ALL-CAA MEN'S BASKETBALL TEAM|url=http://caasports.com/news/2018/3/1/mens-basketball-wright-foreman-tops-all-caa-mens-basektball-team.aspx?path=mbball|website=caasports.com|publisher=Colonial Athletic Association|access-date=7 March 2018|date=2 March 2018}} Following the season Wright-Foreman declared for the [[2018 NBA draft]] but did not hire an agent to preserve his collegiate eligibility.{{cite news|last1=Marcus|first1=Steven|title=Hofstra's Justin Wright-Foreman to test the NBA Draft waters|url=https://www.newsday.com/sports/college/hofstra/justin-wright-foreman-hofstra-nba-draft-b83886|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180408010357/https://www.newsday.com/sports/college/hofstra/justin-wright-foreman-hofstra-nba-draft-1.17614301|url-status=live|archive-date=April 8, 2018|access-date=April 7, 2018|work=NewsDay|date=March 22, 2018}} Coming into his senior season, Wright-Foreman was named Preseason CAA Player of the Year.{{Cite web|url=https://caasports.com/news/2018/10/16/northeastern-favored-to-win-caa-mens-basketball-championship.aspx|title=NORTHEASTERN FAVORED TO WIN CAA MEN'S BASKETBALL CHAMPIONSHIP|website=CAA Sports|language=en|date=October 17, 2018|access-date=October 19, 2018}} On February 9, 2019, Wright-Foreman tied a single-game school-record (set by [[Bill Thieben]]) by scoring 48 points in a win over [[William & Mary Tribe men's basketball|William & Mary]]. The points put Wright-Foreman over the 2,000 point mark for his career.{{cite news|last1=Botte|first1=Peter|title=Justin Wright-Foreman ties Hofstra record with 48 points in victory over William & Mary|url=https://www.newsday.com/sports/college/hofstra/justin-wright-foreman-48-points-william-mary-h30838|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190212011356/https://www.newsday.com/sports/college/hofstra/justin-wright-foreman-48-points-william-mary-1.27109159|url-status=live|archive-date=February 12, 2019|access-date=February 10, 2019|work=NewsDay|date=February 9, 2019}} He was again named CAA Player of the Year for the 2018–19 season.{{cite press release|url=https://caasports.com/news/2019/3/8/hofstras-wright-foreman-repeats-as-caa-mens-basketball-player-of-the-year.aspx|title=Hofstra's Wright-Foreman repeats as CAA men's basketball Player of the Year|publisher=[[Colonial Athletic Association]]|date=March 8, 2019|access-date=March 8, 2019}} == Professional career == === Utah Jazz (2019–2020) === In the [[2019 NBA draft]], Wright-Foreman was selected 53rd overall by the [[Utah Jazz]]. On July 16, 2019, Wright-Foreman was signed to a two-way contract by the Jazz.{{cite web|title=Jazz sign Brantley and Wright-Foreman to two-way contracts|url=https://www.nba.com/jazz/news/jazz-sign-brantley-and-wright-foreman-two-way-contracts|website=NBA.com|access-date=July 17, 2019|date=July 16, 2019}} Wright-Foreman scored 26 points and had seven rebounds and five assists for the [[Salt Lake City Stars]] in a victory over the [[Rio Grande Valley Vipers]] on November 26.{{cite news |title=Jazz's Justin Wright-Foreman: Contributes 26 points in victory |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/jazzs-justin-wright-foreman-contributes-26-points-in-victory/ |access-date=January 13, 2020 |work=[[CBS Sports]] |date=November 26, 2019}} On January 24, 2020, he had 30 points, three rebounds, and four assists in a win over the [[Stockton Kings]].{{cite news |title=Jazz's Justin Wright-Foreman: Stays hot in victory |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/jazzs-justin-wright-foreman-stays-hot-in-victory/ |access-date=February 22, 2020 |work=[[CBS Sports]] |date=January 25, 2020}} === Erie BayHawks (2021) === On December 19, 2020, Wright-Foreman signed an [[NBA salary cap|Exhibit 10]] deal with the [[New Orleans Pelicans]], but was waived the same day.{{cite web|title=Pelicans Waive Four Players|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2020/12/pelicans-waive-four-players.html|date=December 19, 2020|website=HoopsRumors.com|access-date=April 21, 2021|language=en-US}} On January 12, 2021, he signed as an affiliate player with the [[Birmingham Squadron|Erie BayHawks]] of the [[NBA G League]],{{cite web|title=Erie BayHawks' preseason roster includes 3 returnees for NBA G League season|url=https://www.goerie.com/story/sports/nba/2021/01/12/erie-bayhawks-announce-preseason-roster-nba-g-league-season/6646684002/|date=January 12, 2021|website=GoErie.com|access-date=February 10, 2021|language=en-US}} averaging over 12 points and 2 assists in 15 games. === Chorale Roanne (2021) === On April 21, 2021, Wright-Foreman signed with [[Chorale Roanne Basket]] of the [[LNB Élite]].{{Cite news|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/chorale-roanne-ink-justin-wright-foreman/|title=Chorale Roanne ink Justin Wright-Foreman|date=April 21, 2021|newspaper=Sportando|access-date=April 21, 2021|language=En}} He averaged 16.9 points and 3.6 assists per game. === Petkim Spor (2021–2022) === On August 20, 2021, Wright-Foreman signed with [[Petkim Spor]] of the Turkish [[Basketbol Süper Ligi]].{{cite news |title=Justin Wright-Foreman joins Petkimspor |url=https://sportando.basketball/en/justin-wright-foreman-joins-petkimspor/ |website=Sportando |access-date=August 20, 2021 |date=August 20, 2021|last1=Skerletic |first1=Dario }} He averaged 16.8 points, 3.7 assists and 2.1 rebounds per game. Wright-Foreman parted ways with the team on January 28, 2022.{{cite web |last1=Yahyabeyoglu |first1=Fersu |title=Wright-Foreman left Petkim |url=https://www.eurobasket.com/Turkey/news/728587/Wright-Foreman-left-Petkim |website=Eurobasket |access-date=January 28, 2022 |date=January 28, 2022}} === Birmingham Squadron (2022) === On February 10, 2022, Wright-Foreman was acquired and activated by the [[Birmingham Squadron]] of the [[NBA G League]].{{cite web|url=https://gleague.nba.com/transactions/|website=gleague.nba.com|title=2021-22 NBA G League Transactions|date=February 10, 2022|access-date=February 10, 2022}} === Brose Bamberg (2022) === On July 27, 2022, Wright-Foreman signed with [[Bamberg Baskets|Brose Bamberg]] of the German [[Basketball Bundesliga]].{{Cite news|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/justin-wright-foreman-signs-with-brose-bamberg/|title=Justin Wright-Foreman signs with Brose Bamberg|date=August 1, 2022|newspaper=Sportando|language=En|access-date=August 8, 2022|last1=Maggi |first1=Alessandro }} === Westchester Knicks (2023) === On January 30, 2023, Wright-Foreman was acquired by the [[Westchester Knicks]].{{cite web|url=https://gleague.nba.com/22-23-nba-g-league-transactions|website=gleague.nba.com|title=2022-23 NBA G League Transactions|date=January 30, 2023|access-date=January 30, 2023}} === Saskatchewan Rattlers (2023) === On May 29, 2023, Wright-Foreman signed with the [[Saskatchewan Rattlers]] of the [[Canadian Elite Basketball League]].{{cite web|title=NBA-Experienced Guard Joins Roster Ahead of the Home Opener on Wednesday|url=https://www.cebl.ca/nba-experienced-guard-joins-roster-ahead-of-the-home-opener-on-wednesday|work=CEBL.ca|date=May 29, 2023|access-date=May 31, 2023}} Wright-Foreman led the CEBL in scoring during the 2023 season, averaging 29.2 points per game with Saskatchewan.{{cite web|title=CEBL League Leaders 2023 Season - CEBL Player Stats|url=https://www.cebl.ca/league-leaders-2023|website=CEBL.ca|access-date=January 14, 2024}} === Mexico City Capitanes (2023–2024) === On December 27, 2023, Wright-Foreman joined the [[Mexico City Capitanes]],{{cite tweet|author=CAPITANES|title=¡Bienvenido a la #FamiliaCapitán, Justin Wright-Foreman! 🤩🏀 #SomosCapitanes|number=1740063053096558766|user=CapitanesCDMX|date=December 27, 2023|access-date=January 14, 2024|language=Spanish}} but was waived on January 27, 2024.{{cite tweet|author=CAPITANES|title=Capitanes ha finalizado la relación laboral con Justin Wright-Foreman. La #FamiliaCapitán le desea el mejor de los éxitos en su próximo reto profesional 🏀. #SomosCapitanes|number=1751319160380916008|user=CapitanesCDMX|date=January 27, 2024|access-date=January 27, 2024|language=Spanish}} === Carpegna Prosciutto Basket Pesaro (2024) === On February 15, 2024, Wright-Foreman signed with [[Victoria Libertas Pallacanestro|Carpegna Prosciutto Basket Pesaro]] of the Italian [[Lega Basket Serie A]].{{cite web|title=LA CARPEGNA PROSCIUTTO BASKET PESARO FIRMA JUSTIN WRIGHT-FOREMAN|url=https://www.victorialibertas.it/la-carpegna-prosciutto-basket-pesaro-firma-justin-wright-foreman/|website=VictoriaLibertas.it|date=February 15, 2024|access-date=February 15, 2024|language=Italian}} === Winnipeg Sea Bears (2024) === On June 10, 2024, Wright-Foreman signed with the [[Winnipeg Sea Bears]] of the [[Canadian Elite Basketball League]].{{cite web|title=Sea Bears Sign 2023 CEBL Scoring Champion, Justin Wright-Foreman|url=https://www.seabears.ca/sea-bears-sign-2023-cebl-scoring-champion-justin-wright-foreman|website=CEBL.ca|date=June 10, 2024|access-date=October 24, 2024}} === Al-Rayyan (2024–2025) === In October 2024, Wright-Foreman signed with [[Al-Rayyan SC (basketball)|Al-Rayyan]] of the [[Qatari Basketball League]], making his debut on October 21, in a 65–84 loss to [[Al-Arabi SC (basketball)|Al-Arabi]].{{cite web|title=Quarter-Finals Round 1: Al Rayyan - Al Arabi 65-84|url=https://www.asia-basket.com/boxScores/Qatar/2024/1021_2687_3393.asp|website=Asia-Basket.com|date=October 21, 2024|access-date=October 24, 2024}} === Iraklis (2025–2026) === On June 14, 2025, Wright-Foreman signed a one-year contract with [[G.S.
